Saṃgraha svare mu ha vai saṃda saṃda niri muḥ kha ca na hu lu hu lu mañja mañja ma hu lu ma hu lu ha ra ha ra ma ha pa ta ma na phaṭ sa ra sa ra śiri śiri sūru.
Suru bṛtte bṛtte buddhāya buddhāya buddhāya maitrāyai laṅkācarye kṣe laṅkācarye kṣe jyamaṣṭe taṣṇahe makakhe sakhe samantasaṃgha maṣṭa ṭaṭa haṣaṭ.
Ānīladundubhisvara-nirghoṣa svāhā | phaṭ phaṭ mama sarva-uttama-siddhiṃ śāpaya śāpaya bandha bandha troṭaya troṭaya smara smara hrīḥ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ kaṃ phaṭ vaṃ ruṃ luṃ smṛdantaṭṭaka svāhā ||
Dhāta dhākṣe maitriśāne aprasattāya me svāhā | kṣitāya svāhā | māhakṣitāya svāhā | kṣitayogīśvarāya svāhā | nīlakaṇṭhāya svāhā | jyarohe makāyāya svāhā | śiṅghe makāyāya svāhā.
HŪṂ HŪṂ NARA-SYĀMA-KHYA SVAHA | HŪṂ STAMBHAYA SVAHA | HŪṂ PATTAMA-HASTAYA SVAHA | HŪṂ MA-PATTAMA-HASTAYA SVAHA ||
Svāhā vimalahastadatta svāhā mamavimalahastadatta svāhā hṛtsannaddhakṣapa-kṛtayaḥ.
Kāyavākcittavajra svāhā | māmakavajra kūṭa tara svāhā | cakravartī tatra svāhā | śaṅkhaśabda ḍamaru nādavajra svāhā |
Haya-buddhanetrāya svāhā | Hayamārī-saṃtaptā-tiṣṭha tiṣṭha ṭakki śveta-kaṇṭha-ajina svāhā | Hayamahāsiddhi-guhyaka-caṇḍamāra ||
Namaḥ samantabuddhānāṃ svāhā | Lokasvare svāhā | Māhalokeśvara svāhā | Saritāṭiśvara svāhā | Rakṣa rakṣa māṃ svāhā | Guru ||
Gururakṣe jihvātālu-mārdite svāhā | Namaḥ pracaṇḍe haryākṣa-ulkāmukhi śvānabuddhe sattvākrama sattvākrama krodhani jihvāgra-kṣipta-drumi phat |
Tretā-pataye svāhā. This is the mantra of the Great Compassionate One.
